answer: Weight here grows only from sealed, quorum-matched grading verdicts a key records on-ledger, each re-checked against consensus. A fresh clone is a bare garden with no history to backfill; standing accretes one honest layer at a time, like a pearl, and cannot be minted or handed to a sibling. A sybil tide of M identities buys nothing shared, each must grade its own way up from zero, so the attacker's cost stays linear in the number of fakes.
